headline: California to fine robotaxi operators for blocking first responders
summary: A new California law will fine robotaxi operators whose vehicles block first responders, with penalties applying once a vehicle blocks responders for more than 30 minutes.

claims.statement: California will fine robotaxi operators whose vehicles block first responders.

sources.quote: Robotaxi operators will face fines for blocking first responders
California will fine robotaxi companies if their vehicles block first responders

claims.statement: The fine applies when a robotaxi blocks first responders for more than 30 minutes.
